segments.text: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
And the Lord said,

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Hear what the unjust judge saith.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
But Jesus called them unto him, and said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
And a certain ruler asked him, saying,

segments.speaker: certain ruler
segments.text: Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And Jesus said unto him,
Why callest thou me good?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: none is good, save one, that is, God.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: And he said,
All these have I kept from my youth up.
Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
And they that heard it said,

segments.speaker: Those who heard this
segments.text: Who then can be saved?
And he said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Then Peter said,
Lo, we have left all,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: and followed thee.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And he said unto them,
Verily I say unto you,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God’s sake,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
¶ Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
¶ And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
And he cried, saying,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more,

segments.speaker: Those who led the way
segments.text: Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,

segments.speaker: Those who led the way
segments.text: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And Jesus said unto him,
Receive thy sight:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: thy faith hath saved thee.
And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
